source: US Census Bureau TIGERweb (Places_CouSub_ConCity_SubMCD: layer 1 county subdivisions = barrios of the municipios inside config/metro-bounds/san-juan.json, and layer 2 subbarrios of Santurce, which replace the Santurce barrio), downloaded 2026-10-29, simplified to ~10 m. Names as the Census writes them without the word barrio/subbarrio; San Juan's Pueblo barrio is named Rio Piedras and San Juan Antiguo is Old San Juan; a town's own Pueblo barrio is '<Town> Pueblo'; a name two towns share carries its town (or Santurce) in brackets. Who's On First has no Puerto Rico neighbourhoods (checked 2026-10-29).
